description: Energy Access Explorer (EAE) (Energy Access Explorer) is an open energy model listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Open Models", published or maintained by World Resources Institute. WRI, in collaboration with over 300 partners, has developed the Energy Access Explorer (EAE), the World’s First Digital Public Good to deliver climate compatible energy transitions for everyone. EAE takes a data-informed, integrated, and inclusive approach to achieving universal energy access, supporting equitable socio-economic development. Coverage: Africa, Asia. Resolution: time Multi year, geography 1 km. Data availability is given as "some". The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is MIT (as given on the fact sheet). Caveats: this record was written from the openmod wiki fact sheet, which was read; the source code and documentation were not opened, and the sheet may be out of date (it carries no update date). It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
